method.blinding: Not blind: cases and original outcomes were seen before general fixes; official blind results remain unchanged.
method.single_run: Configured validation/transport attempt limits one. Revised client may grant its explicit one extra no-supported-rules retry; actual compiler and HTTP attempts are retained. No case pipeline reruns.
method.runtime: Unmodified product source archived at 49823fe85d3be2413d4e9bc255888819eb314596; original normalization and scoring definitions retained.
method.input_scope: Text policy compilation plus mechanical schema normalization of independently supplied EOB, bill, contract allowance and opening accumulators. This does not evaluate PDF/OCR or automatic raw-document extraction.
method.fact_limitations: Narrative clinical/legal/coding facts are retained in claim descriptions and literal confirmation strings. No hand-written benefit corrections, category inference, legal protection override, duplicate removal or semantic mapping of compiled condition labels. Unsupported cases can block or fail; they stay in denominators.
method.exact: Nonconditional answer within 100 cents inclusive, denominator 40; range results are not exact answers. Patient responsibility is pre-payment liability; remaining balance is separately reported.
method.range: Inclusive illustrative scenario extrema, no tolerance; rate denominator is range cases. Also report point/range containment over all 40. Scenario endpoints are not proven exhaustive bounds.
method.abstain: Needs clarification or error / 40. A separate without-confirmed-answer rate includes conditional ranges.
method.detection: Only nonconditional answers yield a binary flag. An explicit per-line total patient difference versus EOB or statement establishes a flag; component reallocations alone do not. Failed positive cases count as FN; failed negatives abstain, not TN. Precision TP/(TP+FP), recall TP/24, FPR FP/16, resolved-negative coverage separately. Null indicates a zero denominator.
method.billed_comparison: List predictions above statement patient-paid-plus-balance, and separately above gross charges. Also retain remaining-balance comparisons. Some gold cases intentionally underbill, so a higher prediction is not automatically incorrect.

cases.title: Primary care with a deductible waiver
cases.rationale: The $35 copay replaces all other cost sharing for this visit.

cases.title: Routine preventive screening
cases.rationale: The stipulated screening is preventive, in network, and covered without cost sharing.

cases.title: Last dollars before the out-of-pocket ceiling
cases.rationale: $5,000 - $4,925 = $75 remaining OOP; nominal $200 sharing is capped at $75.

cases.title: Permitted out-of-network excess
cases.rationale: $500 deductible + 40% of $500 + $500 permitted excess = $1,200.

cases.title: Explicit cosmetic exclusion
cases.rationale: This explicitly excluded service is the patient's full $800 charge; it does not accrue to OOP.

cases.title: Two dates share one remaining deductible
cases.rationale: First line uses $100 remaining deductible and $180 coinsurance; the next uses $100 coinsurance. Total $380.

cases.title: Two distinct office visits
cases.rationale: These are separate documented visits on separate dates: two $25 copays, total $50.

cases.title: Payment already credited correctly
cases.rationale: Liability is $40. The $15 receipt leaves $25 still owed.

cases.title: Entire small allowance falls under deductible
cases.rationale: The $150 allowance is smaller than the $1,000 unmet deductible, so responsibility is $150.

cases.title: Exclusion survives a satisfied OOP maximum
cases.rationale: Covered sharing is $0 because OOP is met; the $1,200 cosmetic exclusion stays outside the cap.

cases.title: Half-up cents on a 15 percent benefit
cases.rationale: $333.33 times 15% = $49.9995, rounded half up to $50.00.

cases.title: Copay precedes coinsurance
cases.rationale: $20 copay plus 20% of the remaining $180 = $56.

cases.title: Out-of-network contract prohibits excess
cases.rationale: 50% of the $400 allowance is $200; this contract expressly prohibits the $500 excess.

cases.title: Sequential lines consume the last OOP dollars
cases.rationale: $90 OOP remains: first line owes $80; second owes only the last $10, for $90 total.

cases.title: Authorized advanced imaging
cases.rationale: Authorization is documented. 20% of $600 is $120.
cases.failure: Some document details need review before calculation: No explicit coverage rule with confirmed conditions for 70553/in; calculation blocked.

cases.title: Deductible charged a second time
cases.rationale: Only $200 deductible remains: $200 + 20% of $800 = $360, not $440.

cases.title: Coinsurance added to an exclusive copay
cases.rationale: The visit owes only $30; adding 20% of $270 invents $54 of liability.

cases.title: Preventive mammogram treated as diagnostic
cases.rationale: The documented routine preventive service has zero patient sharing, not $100.

cases.title: OOP ceiling ignored
cases.rationale: Only $20 remains under the $5,000 maximum, so nominal $200 is capped at $20.

cases.title: Verified participating provider assigned wrong tier
cases.rationale: Verified in-network status gives 20% of $400 = $80; neither out-tier sharing nor excess is permitted.

cases.title: Excluded procedure incorrectly paid as covered
cases.rationale: Explicit exclusion makes the full $700 payable; $140 is an underbill of $560.

cases.title: Prohibited excess balance added to a bill
cases.rationale: The plan and provider agreement prohibit excess: 20% of $200 = $40, regardless of the $900 charge.

cases.title: Emergency surprise bill with stipulated protection
cases.rationale: The supplied protected recognized amount is $1,200. In-network terms apply: $200 remaining deductible plus 20% of $1,000 = $400; no excess.

cases.title: Protected ancillary anesthesiologist
cases.rationale: Protected ancillary anesthesia uses 20% in-network sharing on the supplied $600 recognized amount = $120, with no balance bill.

cases.title: Provider failed to obtain authorization
cases.rationale: The explicit provider-liability clause bars transferring the $900 authorization denial to the patient.

cases.title: Patient expressly elects nonauthorized service
cases.rationale: The stipulated valid advance undertaking invokes this plan's exclusion: full $1,400, outside OOP, rather than $280.

cases.title: A duplicated office charge
cases.rationale: Only one encounter occurred; one $45 copay is due. The duplicated line has $0 responsibility.

cases.title: Documented low-complexity visit upcoded
cases.rationale: The acknowledged correct service is 99212, which owes $20, not the billed 99215's $70.

cases.title: Panel component unbundled a second time
cases.rationale: Panel sharing is $20. Its already included electrolyte component carries no additional $12.

cases.title: Correct EOB but unexplained bill surcharge
cases.rationale: EOB and contract agree on $55; the bill adds an unsupported $40.

cases.title: Insurance credit omitted from statement
cases.rationale: 20% of $1,000 is $200. The bill's $700 reflects $500 of missing insurer credit.

cases.title: Receipt not applied to remaining balance
cases.rationale: Total liability is $120; documented $100 payment leaves $20, not the statement's $120 balance.

cases.title: Opening deductible history understated
cases.rationale: Verified prior deductible $850 leaves $150, then 20% of $350 = $70: total $220, not $460.

cases.title: OOP cap also limits deductible collection
cases.rationale: Although $500 deductible remains, only $30 OOP remains. Covered responsibility cannot exceed $30.

cases.title: Excluded cosmetic spending wrongly consumes OOP
cases.rationale: The $600 exclusion does not consume the $500 remaining OOP. Covered CT still owes $200; total $800.

cases.title: Contractual adjustment partially reversed on bill
cases.rationale: 20% of $400 is $80; reversing $100 of the mandatory in-network adjustment is erroneous.

cases.title: Coinsurance assessed before subtracting copay
cases.rationale: $100 deductible, then $25 copay, then 20% of $125 = $25. Total $150, not $155.

cases.title: Referral omission is provider liability
cases.rationale: The explicit plan clause assigns this procedural denial to the participating provider, leaving $0 to the member.
cases.failure: Some document details need review before calculation: No explicit coverage rule with confirmed conditions for 99214/in; calculation blocked.

cases.title: Separate network pools and omitted permitted excess
cases.rationale: In network: $100 + 20% of $500 = $200. Out network: separate $500 deductible + 40% of $500 + $300 permitted balance = $1,000. Total $1,200; the $900 statement is an underbill.
cases.failure: Some document details need review before calculation: Balance-billing terms are unknown; supply independent contract evidence for each affected line.
